entities.summary: Fazila Ibrahim gizi Samadova, also known as Fazila Samedova, was an Azerbaijani academician chemical engineer-technologist. She was a Doctor of Chemical Sciences, Honored Scientist, Member of New York Academy of Sciences, Head of the Laboratory at the Research Institute of Petrochemical Processes, Corresponding Member of Azerbaijan National Academy of Sciences (ANAS), Honorary Scientist of Europe.
